name: Takano Hifumi
source:
Takano Hifumi is a doctor and the first researcher to posit the existence of a Hinamizawa Syndrome.

[spoiler]Dr. Takano was also the mentor to Tanashi Takemitsu and would adopt his daughter [url=/c113192]Tanashi Miyoko[/url] after his death, saving her from an orphanage. Miyoko would change her name to [url=/c3861]Takano Miyo[/url] in honor of him and assist with the doctor's research.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Hifumi_Takano]Hifumi Takano[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
